{{Top|leg}}
The '''military flash code''' was a simple code used by the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] as means of sending short-burst transmissions, by utilizing characters in a set sequence in order to transmit information. For example, a dot equaled one, a dash equaled ten, and X equaled five.<ref name="KOTOR II">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

In the year [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="TSL date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' to [[3951 BBY]].</ref> [[Miner/Legends|miners]] [[Skirmish at Peragus II|trapped]] at the [[Peragus Mining Facility]] modified a [[Holotransmitter/Legends|holo-transmitter]] into a crude relay that beamed a military flash code transmission containing the numerical sequence needed to activate the [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] to the Dormitory level of the facility.<ref name="KOTOR II" />
